AI insights

This report is based on sensor data from 20 July 2026 to 26 July 2026. Temperatures ranged from a peak of 31.0°C in Dining on 20 July at 18:10 to a low of 20.4°C in Bed 2 on 25 July at 04:50. Humidity peaked at 69.2% in Bed 2 on 26 July at 03:50 and fell to 39.3% in Dining on 20 July at 18:10. The tightest condensation margin was 4.4°C in Loft 2, comfortably above the 3°C elevated-risk threshold. Against the CIBSE Guide A standard (21°C living areas, 18°C bedrooms, 40-60% RH), the Hall was closest to target at 24.6°C and 51.6% humidity, while Bed 3 was furthest off at 25.8°C against its 18°C bedroom target. Mean indoor temperature fell steadily from 26.3°C to 22.8°C as humidity climbed from 45.5% to 62.1%. Eight rooms cooled together around 07:00 on 24 July, averaging a 1.5°C drop with Network falling 2.6°C, consistent with windows opened for airing. Separately, Dining saw the week's sharpest swing on 20 July, climbing 3.9°C between 17:40 and 18:10 while humidity fell 6.3 points, consistent with evening sun or cooking heat.
